selected_default: int8_per_token_head; CUTLASS NVFP4 weights and Triton attention
limits: Main: 3 interleaved process trials per backend/concurrency, each cold + 3 warm passes; repeated 64-case short workload, not sustained production traffic.
BF16 uses FlashAttention 2; dynamic INT8 uses Triton. This is a complete runtime configuration comparison, not solely a storage precision or GPU-kernel change.
llama.cpp Q8_0 and vLLM INT8 are different quantization formats; weights/calibration and scheduling also differ across engines.
vLLM BF16/INT8 use equal token capacity, not equal byte budgets. Native Q8 reserves full per-slot context, so cross-engine VRAM is not an equal-capacity comparison.
49152/98304 cached tokens do not guarantee all 32/256 slots filled to arbitrary longer contexts without preemption. GPU frequency was not locked.
Quality is a fixed independent OPUS subset with exploratory paired bootstrap, not proof of equivalence across all domains and lengths.
Alternative FP8/backend screens have only one process per configuration and are excluded from the main 3-trial medians.
